sample_unit: endoscopic images of colorectal polyps (376 polyps)

links.outcome: Association between heatmap explanation position relative to annotated polyp and correct AI diagnosis
links.effect: Higher percentage of heatmap covering polyp associated with correct diagnosis in all four algorithms (OR 1.013 to 1.039, all p<0.001); association with uncovered polyp percentage was inconsistent across algorithms.
links.quote: Higher percentages of heatmap covering the polyp were associated with correct diagnoses of four AI algorithms.

screen.reason: Evaluates whether visual explainability features (heatmap coverage/alignment) correlate with diagnostic accuracy to inform clinician trust and interpretation safeguards.
